2. #4412, from the same Moss note: a driver text-prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
3. #8841, from #central-random on 13 Oct: Tobias logged West yard Door 2 double-booking on it. I counted this one because the message calls it "Tobias's dealer account", which is Marrow Fieldworks since he took it over on 5 Jan.
4. PD-5302, from #central-random on 14 Oct: Hollis posted it as one more Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week. The message gives no other detail.

I told her what I left out:
- FR-882 is in the same Moss note, but it belongs to Marrow Agrisupply.
- Moss's other notes have no Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers.
- Nothing in #central-team this week mentions one.

I only used channels Pree is in and files anyone can open. The knowledge brain also turned up Marrow Fieldworks tickets in emails, meeting notes and CRM notes she may not be able to see. They're outside the three sources she named, so I didn't include them.
